exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.description: Gentle spine mobility on hands and knees, rounding and arching the back.

steps: Get on your hands and knees. Hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
Slowly round your back up toward the ceiling and tuck your chin.
Then slowly let your belly sink and look gently forward.
Move only as far as feels comfortable.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you round your back, and in as your belly sinks.
breathCues: Breathe in, belly down, look forward
instructions.commonMistake: Do not force the end of the movement, and keep your arms straight.
instructions.easier: Make the movement smaller. Put a folded towel under your knees.

exercises.name: Arm circles
exercises.description: Big controlled arm circles that warm up the shoulders.

steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold your arms out and draw big, smooth circles.
Keep your neck relaxed and shoulders away from your ears.
After the first set, reverse the direction.
instructions.breathing: Breathe steadily. Do not hold your breath.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not shrug your shoulders up to your ears.
instructions.easier: Make the circles smaller.

exercises.name: Overhead reach
exercises.description: Raise both arms overhead to open up the shoulders and upper back.

steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
Slowly raise both arms forward and up over your head.
Reach gently toward the ceiling. Keep your ribs down and do not arch your back.
Lower your arms slowly back down.
instructions.breathing: Breathe in as you reach up, and out as you lower.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not lean back or lift your ribs.
instructions.easier: Raise your arms only as high as is comfortable.

exercises.name: March in place
exercises.description: Marching on the spot to raise the heart rate gently.

steps: Stand tall.
March on the spot, lifting your knees to a comfortable height.
Swing your arms naturally, opposite arm to leg.
instructions.breathing: Breathe easily and stay relaxed.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not lean back or slump forward.
instructions.easier: Lift your knees lower, or hold on to a chair.

exercises.name: Chair sit-to-stand
exercises.description: Stand up from a chair and sit back down with control.

steps: Sit near the front edge of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart, arms stretched forward.
Lean slightly forward from your hips.
Push through your heels and stand all the way up tall.
Sit back down slowly and with control.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you stand, and in as you sit.
instructions.cue: Sit back, knees over toes, stand tall.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your knees fall inward, and do not flop into the chair.
instructions.easier: Use a higher seat, or push off your thighs with your hands.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.description: Hold a shallow seated position with your back against a wall.

steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet a step forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent a little, like a shallow chair sit.
Keep your whole back against the wall and hold.
Slide back up to finish.
instructions.breathing: Keep breathing steadily. Do not hold your breath.
instructions.commonMistake: Keep your knees over your ankles, not past your toes.
instructions.easier: Do not slide down as far.

exercises.name: Low step-up
exercises.description: Step onto a low step and stand tall, then lower back down.

steps: Stand facing a low, sturdy step, such as the bottom stair. Hold a rail or wall if you need to.
Place one whole foot on the step.
Push through that heel and stand up tall on the step.
Lower back down slowly, then repeat. After the set, switch legs.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you step up, and in as you step down.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not push off the back foot. Drive through the heel on the step.
instructions.easier: Use a lower step and hold on to a rail.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a sturdy table or counter.

steps: Place your hands on a sturdy table or counter, a little wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the table for two seconds.
Push back up, keeping your body straight.
instructions.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, and out as you push up.
breathCues: Breathe in, lower your chest slowly
instructions.cue: Straight line from head to heels, lower for two seconds.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips sag or your head drop.
instructions.easier: Use a higher surface, or do wall push-ups.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.description: A push-up standing at a wall: the easiest way to start pressing.

steps: Stand about an arm and a half from a wall, feet hip-width apart.
Put your hands on the wall at chest height, a little wider than your shoulders.
Bend your elbows and lean your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start, keeping your body in one straight line.
instructions.breathing: Breathe in as you lean in, and out as you push away.
breathCues: Breathe in, lean toward the wall
instructions.commonMistake: Do not stick your bottom out or let your hips sag.
instructions.easier: Stand closer to the wall.
instructions.harder: Step your feet further back, or use a table instead.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.description: Lie on your back and lift your hips by squeezing the glutes.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Arms by your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your shoulders, hips and knees make a straight line.
Squeeze at the top, keeping your ribs down.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you lift, and in as you lower.
instructions.cue: Ribs down, squeeze the glutes, do not arch your back.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not arch your lower back or push up onto your toes.
instructions.easier: Lift your hips only part of the way.

exercises.name: Donkey kick
exercises.description: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg toward the ceiling.

steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
Keep your back flat and your tummy gently tight.
Keep your knee bent and lift one foot up toward the ceiling.
Stop when your thigh is level with your back. Lower slowly. After the set, switch legs.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you lift, and in as you lower.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not swing your leg high, arch your back or twist your hips.
instructions.easier: Lift your leg only a little off the floor.

exercises.name: Backpack row
exercises.description: A one-arm row using a loaded backpack, hinged forward with a flat back.

steps: Hold a backpack with some weight in one hand. Rest your other hand on a chair or counter.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward from your hips, with a flat back.
Let the bag hang down, then pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Lower the bag slowly. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you pull, and in as you lower.
breathCues: Breathe out, pull your elbow to your hip
instructions.cue: Hinge from the hips, back flat, elbow to hip.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not round your back or twist your body.
instructions.easier: Use a lighter bag, or no weight at all.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.description: Step one foot back and lower until both knees bend, then stand.

steps: Stand beside a wall with one hand resting on it, feet together.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent, the front knee above your ankle.
Keep your body upright.
Push through your front heel to stand. Finish one side, then switch.
instructions.breathing: Breathe in as you step back, and out as you stand.
breathCues: Breathe in, step back and lower
instructions.cue: Step back, front knee over the ankle.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your front knee travel past your toes, and do not lean forward.
instructions.easier: Take a smaller step back, or do the split squat instead.

exercises.name: Split squat
exercises.description: Lower straight down in a split stance, front foot forward.

steps: Stand with one foot a big step in front of the other. Hold a wall or chair if you need.
Keep your body upright, back heel lifted.
Bend both knees and lower straight down.
Push through the front heel to rise. Finish one side, then switch the front foot.
instructions.breathing: Breathe in as you lower, and out as you rise.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not lean forward or let your front knee collapse inward.
instructions.easier: Shorten the stance and lower only a little.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.description: Rise onto the balls of your feet and lower slowly.

steps: Stand tall with your fingertips on a wall for balance, feet hip-width apart.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heels slowly back down.
instructions.breathing: Breathe out as you rise, and in as you lower.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not roll your ankles outward. Rise straight up.
instructions.easier: Hold the wall firmly with your whole hand.

exercises.name: Modified curl-up
exercises.description: A small head-and-shoulder lift with hands under the lower back (not a sit-up).

steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Slide both hands, palms down, under the curve of your lower back.
Gently lift just your head and shoulders a little off the floor. Keep your neck long.
Hold, keep breathing, then lower. This is not a sit-up.
instructions.breathing: Breathe normally. Do not hold your breath.
instructions.cue: Lift head and shoulders just clear. This is not a sit-up.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not pull on your neck, and do not flatten your lower back.
instructions.easier: Lift only a tiny amount, or just tighten your tummy.

exercises.name: Side plank (on your knees)
exercises.description: Hold a side bridge on your forearm with your knees bent.

steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent. Rest on your forearm, elbow right under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your shoulders, hips and knees make one straight line.
Hold, breathing steadily.
Lower gently, rest, then switch sides.
instructions.breathing: Breathe steadily. Do not hold your breath.
instructions.cue: Hips and shoulders in one line.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips sag, or roll forward or backward.
instructions.easier: Lift your hips only a little, and rest longer between holds.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.description: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg long and hold.

steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, back flat.
Slowly reach one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back.
Keep your hips level. Do not let your back sag or twist.
Hold, then return and swap sides.
instructions.breathing: Breathe steadily. Do not hold your breath.
instructions.cue: Reach long, do not let the hips twist or the back sag.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips tilt or your lower back sag.
instructions.easier: Lift only the arm, or only the leg.

exercises.name: Lying knee rolls
exercises.description: Lying on your back, let bent knees roll slowly from side to side.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and together, feet flat on the floor.
Let both knees slowly roll to one side, only as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle, then roll to the other side.
Keep your shoulders flat and move slowly.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and let your body relax.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not force your knees down to the floor.
instructions.easier: Use a smaller range.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip-flexor stretch
exercises.description: Half-kneeling stretch for the front of the hip.

steps: Kneel on one knee on a folded towel, with your other foot flat on the floor in front.
Tuck your pelvis slightly, like tilting your belt buckle up toward your chin.
Gently shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Hold and breathe slowly. Do not arch your back.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and deeply while you hold.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not arch your lower back to get more stretch.
instructions.easier: Hold on to a chair for balance and shift forward only a little.

exercises.name: Doorway chest stretch
exercises.description: Stretch the chest and front of the shoulder against a door frame.

steps: Stand in a doorway. Rest your forearm on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward and gently lean through the doorway.
You should feel a mild stretch across your chest. Keep your ribs down.
Hold and breathe. It should never hurt.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and deeply while you hold.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not push into pain or arch your back.
instructions.easier: Lean in only a little.

exercises.name: Wall calf stretch
exercises.description: Stretch the calf with your hands on a wall and one foot back.

steps: Stand facing a wall with your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back, keeping the leg straight and the heel on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean toward the wall until you feel your calf stretch.
Hold and breathe slowly.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly and deeply while you hold.
instructions.commonMistake: Keep the back heel down.
instructions.easier: Step the back foot in a little.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.description: Sit your hips back toward your heels and rest your arms forward.

steps: Start on your hands and knees. Knees about hip-width apart, or wider if that is more comfortable.
Slowly sit your hips back toward your heels.
Rest your arms forward on the floor and let your head relax down.
Breathe slowly into your back. Come up slowly when you finish.
instructions.breathing: Breathe slowly into your lower back.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not force your hips down. Stop if it pinches your knees.
instructions.easier: Place a pillow between your hips and heels, or under your chest. Skip it if bending forward makes your back or knees hurt.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.description: Bodyweight squat: sit your hips back and down, then stand tall.

steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand tall.
instructions.commonMistake: Knees track over your toes; do not let them cave inward.
instructions.easier: Squat to a chair or do a shallower range.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.description: Classic push-up from your toes (or knees) with a straight body line.

steps: Start in a high plank, hands just wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips sag or your head drop.
instructions.easier: Do the push-up from your knees, or against a table or wall.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.description: Forward lunge: step ahead and lower both knees to about 90 degrees.

steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return, then switch legs.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your front knee drift past your toes or your body lean forward.
instructions.easier: Take a shorter step or hold a wall for balance.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a straight line from head to heels on your forearms.

steps: Rest on your forearms with elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body forms one straight line.
Tighten your tummy and glutes and keep breathing.
Hold for the time, then lower with control.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips sag or pike up.
instructions.easier: Drop to your knees, or plank with your hands on a table.

exercises.name: Mountain climber
exercises.description: From a high plank, drive your knees toward your chest in turn.

steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, keeping your hips low and level.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not bounce your hips up or let your shoulders drift back.
instructions.easier: Slow it down and step each foot in rather than driving.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.description: Full-body move: squat, plank, push-up, then jump up.

steps: Stand tall, then squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, then press back up.
Hop your feet in and jump up with your arms overhead.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your lower back sag in the plank.
instructions.easier: Step back and forward instead of jumping, and skip the push-up.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Hip-hinge lift: push your hips back and stand tall with a flat back.

steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, the bar close to your shins.
Hinge at your hips and grip the bar with a flat back.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, bar close to your legs.
Lower the bar with control by pushing your hips back.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not round your back or let the bar drift away from your legs.
instructions.easier: Practise the hip hinge with no weight first, or use light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Bicep curl
exercises.description: Curl a dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping your elbow still.

steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly back down.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not swing your body or let your elbows drift forward.
instructions.easier: Use lighter weights or a water bottle.

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.description: Press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead.

steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms forward.
Brace your tummy and keep your ribs down.
Press the weights straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to shoulder height.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not arch your lower back as you press.
instructions.easier: Press one arm at a time, or use lighter weights.

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.description: Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead, then back.

steps: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet out wide as you raise your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start.
Keep a steady, relaxed rhythm.
instructions.commonMistake: Land softly on the balls of your feet; do not lock your knees.
instructions.easier: Step side to side instead of jumping.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.description: Lift your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abdominal muscles.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Tighten your tummy and lift your head and shoulders off the floor.
Lower back down slowly.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not pull on your neck.
instructions.easier: Keep your hands across your chest and lift only a little.

exercises.name: Bicycle crunch
exercises.description: Alternate elbow-to-opposite-knee while pedalling your legs.

steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while the other leg straightens.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not yank your head with your hands; turn from your trunk.
instructions.easier: Keep your feet on the floor and just twist.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.description: Seated trunk rotation with your feet lifted or on the floor.

steps: Sit with your knees bent and lean back slightly, back straight.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Keep your chest lifted throughout.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not round your back or move only your arms.
instructions.easier: Keep your heels on the floor.

exercises.name: High knees
exercises.description: Run on the spot driving your knees up to hip height.

steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run on the spot, driving each knee up toward hip height.
Swing your arms opposite to your legs.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not lean back as your knees come up.
instructions.easier: March instead of run.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.description: Lying face down, lift your arms and legs to strengthen the back.

steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched forward.
Gently lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold, keeping your neck long and looking at the floor.
Lower slowly.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not crane your neck or lift too high.
instructions.easier: Lift only your arms or only your legs.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.description: Lying on your back, lower opposite arm and leg while keeping your back flat.

steps: Lie on your back with arms straight up and knees bent over your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Slowly lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return and switch sides.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your lower back arch off the floor.
instructions.easier: Move only your legs, keeping your arms still.

exercises.name: Shoulder tap
exercises.description: From a high plank, tap each shoulder with the opposite hand.

steps: Start in a high plank with feet a little wider than hip-width.
Keep your hips as still as you can.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it to the floor and tap with the other hand.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips rock from side to side.
instructions.easier: Widen your feet or do it from your knees.

exercises.name: Jump squat
exercises.description: A squat finished with an explosive jump.

steps: Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive up explosively and jump off the floor.
Land softly with bent knees.
Go straight into the next squat.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not land with locked knees or let them cave inward.
instructions.easier: Do regular squats or rise onto your toes.

exercises.name: Chair tricep dip
exercises.description: Lower and raise your body with your hands on the edge of a chair.

steps: Sit on the edge of a sturdy chair and place your hands beside your hips.
Slide your hips off the seat with your legs bent.
Bend your elbows to lower your body, keeping your back close to the chair.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your shoulders shrug up to your ears.
instructions.easier: Keep your knees bent and feet close to the chair.

exercises.name: Flutter kick
exercises.description: Lying on your back, kick your straight legs up and down in small movements.

steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Lift your legs a little off the floor.
Kick them up and down in small, quick alternating movements.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your lower back arch.
instructions.easier: Raise your legs higher or bend your knees.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.description: Raise straight legs toward the ceiling and lower with control.

steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your back arch as your legs lower.
instructions.easier: Bend your knees slightly or raise one leg at a time.

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height.

steps: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
With soft elbows, raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not shrug or swing the weights up.
instructions.easier: Use lighter weights, such as water bottles.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
exercises.description: Hinge forward and row two dumbbells toward your hips.

steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward from your hips, back flat.
Let the weights hang below your shoulders.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not round your back or jerk the weights.
instructions.easier: Use lighter weights or row one arm at a time.

exercises.name: Side lunge
exercises.description: Step wide to the side and sit back into one hip.

steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and the bent knee over your toes.
Push off to return, then switch sides.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your bent knee cave inward.
instructions.easier: Take a smaller step.

exercises.name: Bear crawl
exercises.description: Crawl forward on hands and feet with your knees just off the floor.

steps: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres.
Keep your back flat and hips low.
Move opposite hand and foot forward together.
Crawl for the time, then reverse back if space is limited.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your hips rise or your back sag.
instructions.easier: Hold the lifted-knee position, or crawl on your knees.

exercises.name: Seated hamstring stretch
exercises.description: Stretch the back of the thigh by reaching toward a straight leg.

steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Sit tall and hinge forward from your hips.
Reach toward your shin until you feel a gentle stretch.
Hold and breathe slowly, then switch legs.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not round your back or bounce.
instructions.easier: Bend the straight knee slightly or sit on a cushion.

exercises.name: Cobra stretch
exercises.description: Lying face down, press up gently to stretch the front of the body.

steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Gently press up, lifting your chest while your hips stay down.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold and breathe, then lower slowly.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not push into pain or force your back to arch.
instructions.easier: Prop up on your forearms instead.

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.description: Pull your heel toward your glute to stretch the front of the thigh.

steps: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance.
Bend one knee and hold your ankle behind you.
Keep your knees together and your hips tucked slightly.
Hold, then switch legs.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not arch your lower back.
instructions.easier: Hold a towel around your ankle.

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.description: Jog on the spot, kicking your heels up toward your glutes.

steps: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Swing your arms naturally.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not lean forward or let your knees drift forward.
instructions.easier: Walk the movement more slowly.

exercises.name: Skater hop
exercises.description: Bound side to side, landing on one leg like a speed skater.

steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing your arms across your body for balance.
Keep the rhythm smooth and controlled.
instructions.commonMistake: Do not let your landing knee collapse inward.
instructions.easier: Step side to side instead of hopping.
